# Oracle fixtures: provenance

Generated by the scripts in `tools/`, each of which carries the workspace's licence
header, and nothing here was copied from any dataset, so no third-party licence
attaches to the fixtures. `README.md` in this directory names the oracle each fixture
records (`filterpy`, `pymap3d`, Stone Soup, `scipy`, or a hand-derived reference) and
the generator that wrote it.

What the fixtures contain is the *numerical output* of running those oracles on inputs
this project chose; no source code of any oracle is reproduced. Each fixture stamps the
oracle's name and version in its `oracle` and `oracle_version` fields so a disagreement
is attributable to a specific release rather than to whatever was on the path.

The fixtures are test evidence only. They are read by differential tests in the
tracking-core crates and are never linked into or shipped with a binary.
